text:
lodash is bumped to 4.17.21 (from 4.17.15), but the tests don't pass: 3 fail in `src/utils/date-utils.spec.js` (DST boundary in America/New_York, local midnight parsing, month-end rollover in local tz).

I haven't shown that these failures predate the bump. My `git stash` baseline run reverted `package.json` and the lockfile, but `node_modules` still held 4.17.21, so it effectively tested the same lodash. The test names point to timezone dependence rather than lodash (my inference, not verified). Likely causes are the machine's TZ or the Node/ICU version.

To confirm, reinstall 4.17.15 and rerun, or run `TZ=America/New_York npm test` on the current code. I also didn't check the `git stash pop` output, so confirm with `git status` that the `package.json` and lockfile changes are back.

I pinned 4.17.21 because it's the latest 4.x release I know of. I didn't query the registry, so `npm view lodash version` will confirm there's nothing newer.
